content.comment_body: Hello, Is there a method to clear log data on the device besides removing the SD card? Thank you, [user_name]
No, file deletion is only possible on a PC using the SD card.
To clarify: can logged data be accessed by other means, such as via Ethernet, or only through the SD card?
You can upload data logs to a PC using [product_name] software. However, if multiple logs exist on the card, only the most recent log can be retrieved. Go to Tools > Transfer > Upload Data Log.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for remote ways to delete or access log data, without needing to physically handle the SD card. Deleting files requires using a PC and the SD card, but partial access (only the latest log) is available through [product_name] software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the capability to remotely delete or view all logged data, ideally via network or software, eliminating the need to physically remove the SD card.
